Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties

Class UsageActivityProperties

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.ClassificationProperties
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.ClassificationBeanProperties
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.openmetadata.properties.UsageActivityProperties
public class UsageActivityProperties extends ClassificationBeanProperties
UsageActivityProperties describes the UsageActivity classification. It is attached to an anchor element (typically an Asset, DigitalProduct or GlossaryTerm) and counts the activity around the element and its anchored elements: how often it is explicitly retrieved, how often it is returned by a search, and how often its properties, attachments and feedback are updated or deleted. Each kind of activity is counted separately.
